This omission occurred at the extraction stage, as the candidate content did not include the offer, and the subsequent ADD operation persisted this incomplete memory. skill_traces.query:
Gina: Hey Jon! Long time no talk! Last week, I built a new website for customers to make orders. It's been a wild ride but I'm loving it. What's up with you? How's the dance studio?
Jon: Hey Gina, congrats on the clothing store! The dance studio is on tenuous grounds right now, but I'm staying positive. I got a temp job to help cover expenses while I look for investors. It's tough, but I'm sure it'll be worth it.
Gina: Thanks, Jon! Appreciate the kind words. Sorry to hear about the studio, but glad to see the positivity. Not easy facing setbacks but I believe in you. Finding investors can be tough, but you've got the passion and experience to make it happen. Rome wasn't built in a day so keep pushing on!
Jon: Thanks for the support. Running a business isn't easy, but I'm determined to make it work. How have you tackled challenges in your business? Got any advice?
Gina: I've had some tough times with my business, Jon. Sourcing trendy pieces for my store was a big hurdle. I had to do a lot of research and networking. My advice? Don't be scared to reach out to people in your field for help and contacts. Networking was a lifesaver for me and opened me up to amazing products that I might not have found otherwise.
Jon: Awesome advice! Lately I've been networking and it's gotten me some good stuff. Really can't beat what connections can do. Check this pic I got from the last networking event!
Gina: Nice one, Jon! Networking really pays off. Connecting with like-minded people is key. How was the event?
Jon: Thanks! The event was awesome. I met some investors and got some good advice. The energy was really motivating, it gave me a boost to go after my goals.
Gina: Wow, Jon! Congrats on the successful night! What are your plans now with the advice you got?
Jon: Taking your advice, I'm sprucing up my biz plan and tweaking my pitch to investors. I'm also working on an online platform to show off the dance studio's stuff.
Gina: Sounds like a great plan, Jon! An online platform can really show off your studio and get investors. Need help with anything?
Jon: Thanks, Gina! Appreciate the offer. Need help with marketing strategies - any advice on reaching my target audience and raising awareness for the dance studio?
Gina: Yeah Jon, marketing is key for getting your dance studio noticed. Instagram and TikTok can help you reach a younger crowd. Posting dance clips or content related to dance can help. You could also collaborate with local influencers or dance communities. I could help you with making content or even managing your accounts if you want.
Jon: Sounds great. I'd really appreciate your help with making content and managing my social media. Let's get together and make the dance studio look awesome!
Gina: Let's create some cool content and manage your social media accounts.
Jon: Thanks for the support. You rock!
Gina: Thanks, Jon! You're awesome. Let's get to work and make your studio shine!
Jon: Definitely, Gina! Let's make our collaboration awesome and bring some dance magic to the world. Can't wait to see what we can do together!
Gina: Definitely, Jon! I'm pumped to collaborate with you and make some sweet moves. Together, we can make a difference and show the world what we can do. Let's go for it!
Jon: Yeah, Gina! We'll rock the dance floor and teach others to chase their dreams. Let's go for it and make an impact!
Gina: Yeah Jon! Let's make a difference and show 'em what we got. We can do amazing things together!
Jon: Thanks for having my back.

selected.name: Capture Brief Project Mentions with Full Attributes
selected.description: Use when a speaker mentions a project they completed, are working on, or plan to build, even briefly.
content: Create an event candidate for any explicit statement of a completed, ongoing, or planned project, even in small talk.
When several messages describe the same project, consolidate them into one candidate and include every explicit attribute stated.
Stop once the speaker has finished describing the project in that session.
selected.rerank_reason: Jon mentions building an online platform for the dance studio, which is a planned project. This fits the trigger of mentioning a planned project.

selected.name: Extract Explicit Advice and Suggestions
selected.description: When a message contains explicit advice, suggestions, or recommendations from one participant to another, extract them as memory candidates.
content: During extraction, treat explicit advice, suggestions, and recommendations as memory-worthy. Capture the advisor, the recipient, the advised action, and the source message.
Preserve all distinct pieces of advice and their qualifiers; do not collapse or omit details. Tentative phrasing still counts.
Represent as an event or relationship memory; create at most one candidate per distinct piece of advice.
Stop after capturing the stated advice; do not infer outcomes or expand into related topics.
selected.rerank_reason: Gina offers specific advice on marketing strategies and social media management, which directly qualifies as explicit advice to Jon.

nearby_not_selected.name: Extract Offers, Encouragement, and Advice
nearby_not_selected.description: Use during extraction when a message contains one person offering help, giving advice, encouragement, or reassurance to another person.
content: During extraction, treat a single message as sufficient evidence when a speaker offers help, gives advice, encouragement, or reassurance to another person.
Create one event memory capturing the speaker, the recipient, and the gist of what was said, including any explicit guidance or offer topic.
Stop after the gist is captured; do not infer the recipient's internal feelings or expand into multiple memory kinds unless the message contains other distinct facts.

nearby_not_selected.name: Extract Inspiration and Plan Memories
nearby_not_selected.description: Use when a user mentions what inspired or motivated their current or future project.
content: During extraction, treat statements like 'X sparked ideas for my [project]' as a plan/state memory candidate.
Do not skip a turn just because it contains no direct question; extract motivation and project details from casual narrative.
Resolve relative time from the message/session timestamp and include it in the memory.

nearby_not_selected.name: Extract Explicit Goals and Intended Impact
nearby_not_selected.description: Use when a message states a hope, goal, dream, or intended impact for an activity or interest.
content: During extraction, if a message explicitly states a user's goal, hope, aspiration, or intended impact for an activity (e.g., share stories, make a difference, reach others), capture it as a separate facet in the memory content; do not replace it with only current emotional benefits like escape, expression, or healing.
When enriching an existing memory, preserve previously stored facets and ADD the newly stated goal or impact rather than overwriting the memory with a narrower paraphrase.
Stop after capturing the explicit goal and its immediate context; do not enumerate every possible future hope or infer unstated ambitions.

nearby_not_selected.name: Location Qualifiers for Named Destination Plans
nearby_not_selected.description: When extracting or updating a plan memory that mentions a specific named venue, landmark, or business, include its commonly known location(s) so future location questions can be answered.
content: During extraction, if a plan memory mentions a specific named venue, landmark, or business, add a concise qualifier naming its well-known location(s), e.g., US states or countries.
Use only common knowledge about that entity; do not research or speculate beyond obvious, widely known locations.
If one location is commonly known, record it; if several prominent locations exist, record all commonly known ones, then stop.
Apply the same qualifier when updating an existing plan memory that references the venue.

nearby_not_selected.name: Extract Shared Bonding-Activity Memories
nearby_not_selected.description: When a user reflectively describes a past shared activity with a specific person and frames it as bonding, making memories, or quality time.
content: During extraction, treat first-person statements about a past shared activity with a named person that explicitly mention bonding, making memories, closeness, or quality time as a durable event or relationship memory candidate.
Capture the activity, the companion, and the relational framing.
Do not require explicit fact-like phrasing; reflective storytelling is sufficient evidence.
Create at most one candidate per distinct activity-and-companion pair, and skip statements that name no specific person or activity.
